title: Class decorators: @dec above class

kcs.statement: @dec above class C: ... is equivalent to C = dec(C) applied after the class body has executed; the decorator expression itself is evaluated before the class body runs, and stacked class decorators apply bottom-up.
A class decorator usually modifies the class in place, for example adding a method with setattr, and returns the same class so isinstance and subclassing keep working.

problem_ideas: Write @add_repr that adds a __repr__ listing instance attributes
Write @register_model that records the class in a registry dict
Desugar a class with two stacked class decorators
Predict what happens when a class decorator forgets to return the class
Write @freeze that adds a __setattr__ raising after __init__
Predict whether a print in a class decorator factory or in the class body appears first
